description: This file is a Python script that checks the licenses of Python package dependencies against configured acceptable and unauthorized license lists. It reads configuration from an ini file, fetches license info from PyPI, and reports compliance status for packages in a requirements.txt file.

classes.name: PackageLicense
classes.description: Data class representing license information for a package, including name, version, license type, authorization status, and reason.

classes.name: LicenseChecker
classes.description: Main class responsible for parsing configuration, fetching package licenses, checking compliance, and generating reports for package licenses based on requirements.

methods.name: __init__( self, config_file: Path = Path("./tests/code_coverage_tests/liccheck.ini") )
methods.description: Initializes the LicenseChecker with configuration, license lists, authorized packages, and loads cache if available.

methods.name: Set[str] _parse_license_list(self, section: str, option: str)
methods.description: Parses a list of licenses from a config section and option, handling comments and whitespace.

methods.name: Dict[str,Dict[str,str]] _parse_authorized_packages(self)
methods.description: Parses the list of authorized packages along with their version specifications and comments.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_package_license_from_pypi( self, package_name: str, version: str )
methods.description: Fetches license information for a given package and version from PyPI API.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] is_license_acceptable(self, license_str: str)
methods.description: Determines if the given license string is acceptable based on configured license lists, including special handling for BSD variants.

methods.name: bool check_package(self, package_name: str, version: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Checks if a package (and optional version) is compliant, considering authorization config and license acceptance.

methods.name: bool check_requirements(self, requirements_file: Path)
methods.description: Reads and parses the requirements.txt file and checks all listed packages for license compliance.

ctags.pattern: /^    def _parse_license_list(self, section: str, option: str) -> Set[str]:$/

ctags.name: check_package
ctags.pattern: /^    def check_package(self, package_name: str, version: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:$/

ctags.pattern: /^    def is_license_acceptable(self, license_str: str) -> Tuple[bool, str]:$/
